articles.summary: Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) today announced that Chief Executive Officer Glenn Fogel will participate in a fireside chat at the J.P. Morgan 2026 Global Technology, Media and Communications Conference, held in Boston, on May 20th beginning at 11:20 am EST. A live audio cast of the presentation will be available to the public at https://ir.bookingholdings.com/events , and a replay will be available approximately 24 hours later.
